question: Does usage spelling provide distinct meaningful obligations outside test-path dominance?
prior_context: Original six source reviews are complete: four limited opportunities (three test fixtures and fmt) and two necessary differences; no production core benefit established. These outcomes motivate one fixed subset batch, not labels for the new candidates.
timing_policy: Record preflight/loading, subset ranking computation and serialization separately using monotonic elapsed time. Reference the prior extraction elapsed_seconds and its measured 812-unit scope separately; do not rerun extraction, sum it into a subset end-to-end runtime, or claim performance from one runtime. Timings are telemetry, not ranking inputs or selection criteria.
original_freeze_policy: Before and after ranks, check current original code baseline runner/protocol/helpers/bags/scope against the original common-budget freeze, and current original call-view runner against its frozen hash. No original source or frozen artifact may be edited.

population.base: Exactly the same 812 common-scope code-eligible IDs
population.meaning: not-test-path-hint and non-nested only; not confirmed production
population.preserve: Retain every selected ID including empty or rejected call rows as zero vectors; no exclusion by call content, cfg, file identity or eventual rank.

methods.code: Use unchanged decoded token Counters; sum multiset intersection / max(total token lengths), for all unordered subset pairs. No IDF, renaming, stopword removal or retokenization.
methods.call_set: Named call_expression/method_expression only; binary U:JSON([kind,deferred_depth,name]) features, JSON ensure_ascii=False with default separators, same spelling convention as prior call_set. Opaque macros and null names excluded from features but counted. No call_order, fusion or winner selection.

weighting.idf_fit: Refit on all 429 subset rows including empty/rejected rows; idf=ln((1+429)/(1+df))+1. No reuse of 812 IDF.
weighting.empty_vocabulary: Return zero matrix with 429 rows, preserve population and report lack of vocabulary.

ranking.pair_universe: All unique unordered pairs in lexicographic combination order, including same-file pairs; expected 91806.
ranking.sort: positive rounded scores descending then canonical unit_id pair ascending
ranking.zero_pairs: Save full rounded score arrays including zeros; zeros never padded into top lists
ranking.cutoff_ties: Report entire-universe count at cutoff, count strictly above, selected-at-cutoff and tie members beyond budget for top20 and top100

review_selection.exclusive_definition: Method's own positive top20 minus the other method's positive top20 BEFORE exposure exclusions.
review_selection.exclude: Reviewed SCC ledger pairs (review_status=reviewed), every pair in prior doc review queue (conservative exposure; their unknown status is not a truth label), and all original six queue pairs.
review_selection.within_stream: Rank ascending within each exclusive top20, retaining original method rank; select next unexcluded pair for each slot.
review_selection.exhaustion: Record empty slot and reason when its stream is exhausted; do not substitute the other stream, select below top20, expand tie groups or relax exclusions.
review_selection.unchosen: Preserve all eligible/blocked stream members and exclusion reasons for audit; no manual choice.

diagnostics: opaque macro, deferred, null name counts
test_path_hint, explicit test-like direct/ancestor/file attribute hints and cfg caveats, not test execution classification
cutoff ties and top20 singleton/shared feature fingerprints
overlap between methods and previously exposed pairs
unknown reference outcomes; no effectiveness/precision/recall labels
controls: Compare binary smoothed-IDF normalized vectors against independent formula; identical/disjoint/empty/repeated token cases.
Verify code overlap/max formula on small explicit Counters.
Verify macro/null filtering, deferred identity preservation and rejected-record zero row.
Verify empty vocabulary preserves all rows and alternating selection exhaustion cannot widen top20.
repeat_check: Both runs consume identical frozen inputs/protocol/script/helper, use independent output directories and refit independently. Compare every deterministic artifact and full score array; record command/environment separately and compare scientific fields excluding only command/path telemetry. Refuse output overwrite.
limits: Four-package development-exposed historical corpus; 429 is not confirmed production.
No resolved APIs, type checking, macro expansion, cfg activation or execution proof.
Removing path-hinted tests does not remove all tests or generic wrappers; same-file pairs retained.
All failures and ties remain evidence; ranking novelty is not meaningful obligation or architecture benefit.
stop: After exactly two frozen runs and repeat validation, pause packaging-ready for independent source review. No new labels, model dispatch, review packaging, parameter/stopword/threshold tuning or population expansion in this batch. If independent review still finds only generic templates/tie artifacts without distinct meaningful obligations, stop this route rather than add variants to pursue a winner.
